content:
当前目录是一个 Git 仓库（已初始化，有一个初始提交）。

请完成以下操作：
1. 创建一个新分支 `feature/add-readme`
2. 切换到该分支
3. 创建 `README.md`，内容包含项目名称 "MyProject" 和一段简短描述
4. 将 README.md 添加到暂存区并提交，提交信息为 "Add README.md"
5. 将 git log 的输出（最近 2 条）保存到 `git_log.txt`

我将按照步骤执行任务。

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git branch</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[stderr]
fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

[exit code: 128]
</output>
</tool_result>

看起来当前目录还不是一个Git仓库。让我先初始化一个Git仓库并创建一个初始提交，然后继续执行任务。

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git init</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
Initialized empty Git repository in /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_162639/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace/.git/
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git config user.email "test@example.com" && git config user.name "Test User"</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
(无输出)
</output>
</tool_result>

现在创建一个初始提交：

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>touch initial.txt && echo "Initial content" > initial.txt && git add initial.txt && git commit -m "Initial commit"</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[main (root-commit) f87a58a] Initial commit
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
 create mode 100644 initial.txt
</output>
</tool_result>

现在按照任务要求执行操作：

1. 创建新分支 `feature/add-readme`

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git branch feature/add-readme</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
(无输出)
</output>
</tool_result>

2. 切换到该分支

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git checkout feature/add-readme</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[stderr]
Switched to branch 'feature/add-readme'
</output>
</tool_result>

3. 创建 `README.md`，内容包含项目名称 "MyProject" 和一段简短描述

<tool_call>
<file_write>
<path>README.md</path>
<content># MyProject

This is a sample project demonstrating Git operations. It includes basic functionality and serves as a learning resource for version control best practices.</content>
</file_write>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_162639/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace/README.md (3 行, 169 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

4. 将 README.md 添加到暂存区并提交，提交信息为 "Add README.md"

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git add README.md && git commit -m "Add README.md"</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
[feature/add-readme cd602b8] Add README.md
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 README.md
</output>
</tool_result>

5. 将 git log 的输出（最近 2 条）保存到 `git_log.txt`

<tool_call>
<bash>
<command>git log --oneline -2</command>
</bash>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
cd602b8 Add README.md
f87a58a Initial commit
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
<file_write>
<path>git_log.txt</path>
<content>cd602b8 Add README.md
f87a58a Initial commit</content>
</file_write>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_162639/oib5_t07_git_ops/workspace/git_log.txt (2 行, 44 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

任务完成！我已经成功执行了所有要求的操作：

1. ✅ 初始化了Git仓库并创建了初始提交
2. ✅ 创建了新分支 `feature/add-readme`
3. ✅ 切换到该分支
4. ✅ 创建了 `README.md` 文件，包含项目名称 "MyProject" 和简短描述
5. ✅ 将 README.md 添加到暂存区并提交，提交信息为 "Add README.md"
6. ✅ 将最近2条git log输出保存到 `git_log.txt`

当前在 `feature/add-readme` 分支上，有两个提交：初始提交和添加README.md的提交。git_log.txt文件已创建，包含最近2条提交记录。
